# elmah.io Documentation

> Documentation on how to install and use elmah.io, the error logging and uptime monitoring service for .NET. Covers SDK setup for every major .NET web/logging framework, JavaScript, mobile, the CLI, and the MCP server for AI assistants.

## Getting Started

- [Quick start](https://docs.elmah.io/): Sign up and send your first error.
- [Authentication](https://docs.elmah.io/authentication/)
- [Integrations high level overview](https://docs.elmah.io/integrations-high-level-overview/)

## MCP Server (connect elmah.io to AI assistants)

- [Set up MCP Server](https://docs.elmah.io/setup-mcp-server/)
- [elmah.io AI Plugin](https://docs.elmah.io/elmah-io-ai-plugin/)
- [Add MCP Server to Claude Code](https://docs.elmah.io/add-mcp-server-to-claude-code/)
- [Add MCP Server to Claude Desktop](https://docs.elmah.io/add-mcp-server-to-claude-desktop/)
- [Add MCP Server to ChatGPT](https://docs.elmah.io/add-mcp-server-to-chatgpt/)
- [Add MCP Server to Cursor AI](https://docs.elmah.io/add-mcp-server-to-cursor-ai/)
- [Add MCP Server to Perplexity AI](https://docs.elmah.io/add-mcp-server-to-perplexity-ai/)
- [Add MCP Server to Visual Studio](https://docs.elmah.io/add-mcp-server-to-visual-studio/)
- [Add MCP Server to VS Code](https://docs.elmah.io/add-mcp-server-to-vs-code/)
- [Call MCP Server Using an API Key](https://docs.elmah.io/call-mcp-server-using-api-key/)
